LESSON: GOOD EATING HABITS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.6: Good eating habits

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Good eating habits using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Good eating habits in the examples.
2. Explain Good eating habits to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Good eating habits.
4. Show that you can: statehow food is apportioned on on a plate (proteins, vegetables, 2.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Good eating habits using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Good eating habits important for a Grade 2 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

1. Identify suitable foods that promote health when apportioning using realia or pictures or simulations.
